organization_or_parent_framework: NWO (Dutch Research Council), Domain Applied and Engineering Sciences (AES)
executive_summary: NWO Domain AES call for public-private research programmes that (further) develop one or more of the 44 key enabling technologies (TRL 1-6) in line with the Knowledge and Innovation Agendas of the Dutch Mission-driven Innovation Policy, including Climate & Energy. Researchers at Dutch universities and institutes apply (at least three Dutch research organisations, two of them universities), together with users from the whole innovation chain; one user representative must act as co-lead. Users receive no NWO grant and must co-fund at least 10% of the required funding in cash and at least 30% of total project costs in cash or in kind. Total budget EUR 26.5 million; grant EUR 2-5 million per project, about six projects, maximum duration 6 years. Three stages: the mandatory letter of intent was due 6 October 2026 (only consortia that submitted one can continue), pre-proposals are due 24 November 2026, 14:00 CET, and full proposals 25 May 2027, 14:00 CEST; decision expected mid-November 2027.
status_rationale: Perspectief funds high-risk, early-stage development of key enabling technologies (TRL 1-6) by consortia of Dutch research organisations and users, aligned with missions including Climate & Energy (Call for proposals, sections 1.1, 2.1 and 2.2.1). It touches TenneT's field because energy applications of technologies such as AI and digital twins are within scope, as in TenneT's Unlocking Digital Twin Capabilities programme with NWO, NFDTES, TenneTwin and GNN4GC. TenneT cannot apply or receive a grant (users never receive NWO funding), but it can join as user, co-funder (cash and in kind, which the call requires from users) or co-lead on behalf of the users (sections 3.2.2, 3.2.5 and 3.6.1); the mandatory letter of intent closed on 6 October 2026, so this route is only open through a consortium that submitted one. The category is a research-led project in which TenneT takes part as user or co-funder without a grant.
